verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a RESTful API for managing resources programmatically, a JS SDK, and an official CLI, all authenticated with API keys. Machine creation is explicitly offered through console, API, or CLI. However, nothing shows UI parity across other features such as templates, shared drives, auto-shutdown, notebooks, or deployments, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented API coverage of templates, shared drives, auto-shutdown, notebooks and deployments; any explicit API-UI parity statement; a published OpenAPI spec; independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness.
